subject: Rude gate agent at Delhi T3
body: The gate agent on AeroVista flight AV 482 rolled her eyes and told me to 'figure it out' when I asked about my seat. Absolutely unacceptable way to treat a paying passenger. - Rohan Mehta

subject: 7 hours on the tarmac and not one update
body: Dear Customer Care, my Nimbus Air flight from Lagos to London on 14 October was delayed by almost seven hours and nobody at the desk could tell us anything. We were handed a water bottle and told to wait. I have travelled with you for years and this is the worst handling of a delay I have seen. Kind regards, Chidi Okafor

subject: Re: Re: Re: Lost luggage PNR XK92LM
body: This is now my third email and I have received nothing except an automated acknowledgement. My bag went missing on SkyBridge flight SB 207 from Mumbai to Frankfurt on 3 October and the baggage desk at Frankfurt told me to file a report online. I filed it. The reference number is FRA-88213. On 9 October a call centre agent named Dieter promised a call back within 48 hours, and nobody has called. On 16 October I wrote again and was ignored. My bag held medication for my mother and my work laptop, so this is not a small inconvenience. If I do not hear from a real person by Friday I will post the whole sequence on social media and contact the aviation regulator. Anil Deshpande

subject: Very disappointed
body: u advertised FLY ANYWHERE fares from 2999 and there was not a single seat at that price on any date i tried?? feels like a bait and switch honestly

subject: Filthy cabin on IW 6E-318
body: Seat 14C had a stain on it that looked like vomit and the tray table was sticky. I asked the cabin crew to clean it and was told there was no time. Is this the standard you are proud of? Not even a sorry. Sarah Lindqvist

subject: Waited 75 min for 2 dosas
body: 75 minutes for TWO dosas at Saravana Corner Anna Nagar on Sunday and nobody even came to say sorry. we had kids with us and they were crying by the end

subject: Poor treatment at your Manchester branch
body: Good afternoon, I dined at Bella Notte on Deansgate on Saturday 17 October with my husband for our anniversary. Our waiter, who did not give his name, was dismissive from the start and sighed when we asked for a recommendation. He cleared our plates while I was still eating and then ignored us for twenty minutes. I did not raise my voice or make a scene, but I want it on record that this was not the evening we paid for. Regards, Emma Whitfield

subject: Cockroach at table 9 - Spice Route Kitchen
body: we ate at Spice Route Kitchen in Kothrud Pune on 11 Oct around 8:30pm. a cockroach crawled across the table next to ours while the food was being served, and when I pointed it out the staff just wiped it away and said nothing. my son has asthma and a weak stomach and he was ill the next day. I expect the owner to take this seriously because this is a food safety issue and I will report it to the FSSAI helpline if I do not get a proper response. Vikram Joshi

subject: Unlimited buffet that wasn't
body: Your poster at Tandoor Junction said UNLIMITED buffet for Rs 899. After 45 minutes they started stopping refills and told us the buffet closes at 90 minutes from seating, which was written nowhere. I was also charged a service fee I did not agree to and would like that explained. The real issue is how the advertisement and the staff attitude made us feel tricked. Meena Subramanian

subject: Thanks for the cold biryani
body: Wow, cold biryani and a warm attitude from the manager. Truly a premium dining experience at Nawab's Table. Keep up the good work.

subject: Re: Re: Re: Account access ticket - no reply
body: To the Customer Relations Team, I have now sent four emails to Meridian Trust Bank over three weeks about the way my branch handled my mother's account closure after my father passed away, and none of them have been answered. I first wrote on 28 September and again on 5 October, 12 October and 19 October, each time quoting case number MT-2209417. The branch manager, Mr Hollis, told me in person he would escalate it and nothing has happened. I am not asking for anything unreasonable, just a reply from a human being who has read what I wrote. Being ignored at such a painful time has been worse than the original problem. If I do not receive an answer this week I will take the matter to the banking ombudsman. Yours sincerely, Grace Ndlovu

subject: Appalling behaviour by manager at T. Nagar branch
body: I want to put on record what happened at the Kaveri Cooperative Bank T. Nagar branch on 6 October at around 11:15 am. I went to ask why my fixed deposit receipt was not ready, and the branch manager, Mr Ramesh, told me in front of other customers that elderly people should come with their children if they cannot understand banking. When I asked for his name and for the complaints register he refused to hand it over and walked away. The cashier, Ms Latha, was kind but said she was not allowed to give me the register. I am 71 years old and have banked here for thirty-four years. I have written to the head office address on your website and received no acknowledgement. I would like a senior officer to read this, and I would like an apology. Subramaniam Iyer

subject: 2 hours in a queue for a passbook
body: 2 hours 10 minutes in the queue at your Whitfield Street branch for a simple passbook update. Only one counter open out of six and the rest of the staff were drinking tea. Is this the service we are paying for?

subject: Considering closing my accounts
body: I have been with Harbor & Pine Bank for twelve years, and I am writing calmly because I would rather you hear this before I act. Over the past six months I have been transferred between departments, kept on hold for long periods and given conflicting answers by staff who seem to have no authority to decide anything. I have a mortgage, two savings accounts and my business account with you, and I am now comparing other banks. I would welcome a call from someone senior who can address the overall experience. Daniel Okonkwo

subject: your app keeps crashing and nobody cares
body: Your mobile banking app has crashed every single time I try to log in for the last 10 days and the helpline agents just keep telling me to reinstall it. Reinstalled 4 times. The agent on 20 Oct even laughed when I said I was trying to pay my rent. I dont even need a fix at this point, I just want somebody at your end to take responsibility for how badly this is being handled. Pooja Nair

subject: Sixth ticket and the network is STILL down
body: Hello VoltaTel, this is the sixth time I am contacting you about the same problem and my patience is gone. Since 2 October there has been no signal in my flat in Whitefield, Bangalore, except at the window, and I have raised six tickets, the latest being VT-77214. Each time an engineer is promised and none arrive. On 15 October one engineer did come, said it was a tower issue and left within five minutes. I work from home and my calls drop in the middle of client meetings. I have paid your premium postpaid plan for two years without a single late payment. Please escalate this to someone who can actually fix how you handle customers like me. Arjun Reddy

subject: unlimited 5g my foot
body: u said UNLIMITED 5G in the ad and speeds drop to 64kbps after 50GB. thats not unlimited thats a lie. very misleading

subject: Porting out on Monday
body: If nobody from ConnectOne calls me before Monday I am porting my number to another operator. This is your final warning after three weeks of excuses.

subject: No one picks up and no one writes back
body: Good evening, I have called the Zephyr Mobile helpline eleven times in the last week and either the line cuts off or I am left on hold for forty minutes. I also wrote to the support email on the 12th and again on the 18th. I am tired of being passed around with nobody taking responsibility. Please, could someone just respond to me. Lakshmi Prabhu

subject: Treated like a nuisance at your Koramangala store
body: I went to the Airlynx store in Koramangala on Thursday to ask about a charge on my bill, and the staff behaved as if I was wasting their time. One person told me to call customer care and turned away. The billing amount is a separate matter, what bothers me most is the attitude and that nobody wanted to help. Kiran Hegde

subject: Four hours in the ER
body: I brought my grandmother to the emergency department at St. Aldric Medical Centre on the night of 19 October with chest pain and she waited almost four hours before a doctor saw her. Reception told us there was no one free, while we watched staff chatting by the desk. She is 82 and we were terrified. Nobody apologised and nobody checked on her while she waited. Someone in management needs to explain how a cardiac complaint is left sitting in a plastic chair. Michael Torres

subject: nurse was very rude to my father
body: The night nurse on ward 3B at Lakeview Hospital snapped at my father when he asked for water. He is recovering from surgery and was already scared. Please speak to her.

subject: Unclean ward at Lakeview Hospital
body: Dear Sir or Madam, my husband was admitted to Lakeview Hospital in room 214 from 8 to 12 October. The bedsheets had stains that were not changed for two days and the attached washroom had a foul smell and a leaking tap. When I told the ward attendant he said housekeeping would come, but nobody did until my husband's discharge morning. A hospital should be a place that protects patients from infection, not exposes them to it. I would appreciate a visit from someone in senior management. Anjali Kulkarni

subject: Nobody answers at Sunrise Multispeciality
body: Good morning. I have telephoned the front desk of Sunrise Multispeciality Hospital at least six times since 14 October to ask about an appointment slot for my mother, and no one has answered or returned my voicemails. I also wrote to your enquiry address on 17 October. It is disappointing that a hospital is so difficult to reach when people are already worried. Thank you, Rajesh Venkataraman

subject: Formal escalation regarding my father's care
body: I am writing to formally escalate my family's experience at Greenfield Hospital in Hyderabad, where my father was treated between 22 September and 1 October under Dr. Anand in the cardiology department. On three separate days his morning medicines were delayed by over two hours, and the nurses on duty gave different explanations each time. When I asked to see the senior consultant on 28 September I was told he was unavailable, and no one came back to me afterwards. The patient relations desk, represented by a Ms Fathima, took my details on 30 September and I have heard nothing since. My father has been home for three weeks and I am still waiting for a callback from anyone in a position of responsibility. I have attached the dates and names in this message so that nothing has to be explained again. If I do not hear from your management within seven days, I will approach the consumer forum and the state medical council. Karthik Narayanan

subject: Parcel stuck for 12 days
body: My parcel with SwiftRoute Couriers has been stuck at the Hyderabad hub since 10 October with tracking number SR4481920 and every call to your helpline gives a different excuse. It was a birthday gift that is now useless. Shocking lack of accountability. Neha Kapoor

subject: Delivery boy was abusive
body: Your delivery guy in HSR Layout threw my package at the door and swore at me when I asked him to be careful. Sort out your people.

subject: Re: Re: Parcel stuck - 3rd email
body: Hello, this is the third time I am writing about shipment BL-20931 from Blue Lantern Express, which was due in Pune on 2 October and has still not arrived. On 8 October I received an email saying someone would call me, and nobody did. On 14 October I wrote again and the reply was an automatic message with a ticket number that does not exist when I enter it on your website. I spoke to a supervisor named Imran on 20 October by phone and was promised an update by evening. That was three days ago. I run a small online business and my customers are asking me where their order is. I am extremely unhappy with how I have been ignored and I will leave a public review and take this to the consumer forum if I do not get a reply. Farah Sheikh

subject: Opened and damaged package
body: Hi, the parcel I received from QuickDrop Logistics yesterday had its tape cut open and the box was crushed on one side. The seller wants proof and I assume I'll have to claim some money back, but what I really want to say is how carelessly your staff handled it. The delivery executive also did not wait for me to check it. Sofia Marquez

subject: Moving 40 parcels a week elsewhere
body: We ship about 40 parcels a week with your company and the last month has been poor, with late pickups on four occasions and nobody answering the account manager's phone. I am raising this calmly but I am looking at other carriers. Please have someone senior contact me. Imran Qureshi, Qureshi Textiles

subject: Sea view? It was a car park
body: Hello Pearl Bay Resort, we stayed in room 305 from 4 to 7 October based on your website photos advertising an ocean-view deluxe room in Goa. The view was the staff parking area and a wall. When we mentioned it at the front desk we were told that the picture is only for illustration. We felt misled and the stay was spoiled from the first evening. Ravi Menon

subject: Bed bugs at Grand Orchid KL
body: I stayed at the Grand Orchid in Kuala Lumpur from 26 to 29 September in room 1418. On the second night I woke with bites and found small insects along the seams of the mattress, which I photographed. I told the front desk at 6 am and was offered another room with no apology and no question about my health. I also had to repack everything at once because I was afraid of carrying them in my luggage. My wife and I had to throw away some clothes when we returned to Singapore. This is a basic hygiene failure and the way it was handled made it worse. I would like management to look into this properly and tell me what they are doing. Wei Jie Tan

subject: Front desk was dismissive
body: The woman at the front desk of Harbourview Inn was barely polite and could not wait to get rid of us. Small thing perhaps but it left a bad impression. - Tom

subject: 3 hour wait to check in
body: We landed at 6 am after a long overnight journey and were told our room at the Meridian Suites in Dubai would be ready in an hour. It was almost 3 pm before we got a key. Nobody offered a drink or a lounge to wait in and the receptionist just kept repeating the same line. We are exhausted and quite disappointed. Olga Petrova

subject: Request to speak with the General Manager
body: Dear General Manager, I am writing because my attempts to resolve my experience at your Jaipur property, the Rajmahal Heritage, have gone nowhere at the desk level. During our stay from 9 to 12 October the room service was cold and late every day, the AC in room 112 failed twice and housekeeping did not return after the second request. The duty manager, Mr Chauhan, offered a complimentary dessert, which does not address the issue. I would like you personally to review what happened. Priya Raman

subject: Gym equipment broken for 2 months
body: Hello, the treadmills on the first floor at FitNation Adyar have been out of order since the first week of August, and the AC has failed twice in the last month. I have mentioned it to the front desk three times and was told that the technician will come soon. Nothing has changed. It is tiring to keep paying full price for half a gym. Deepa Chandran

subject: No joining fee was a lie
body: The offer at IronWorks Gym said NO joining fee and then they added a Rs 2500 registration charge plus a mandatory trainer package. I did not receive any of this in writing and I was pressured at the desk. The payment aside, it is the way the offer was sold to me that I want to complain about. Sanjay Patel

subject: Trainer ignored me
body: The trainer at PowerHouse Gym in Dwarka spent my entire personal training session on his phone. I am not paying to watch someone scroll.

subject: will cancel my membership
body: if the treadmills at FlexZone arent fixed by next month im cancelling my membership. i have asked 4 times already

subject: Pool closed again
body: I joined Aqua Fit Club in Whitefield mainly for the swimming pool and it has now been closed for five weeks under the label of maintenance. Nobody has given us a date for when it will reopen. I am sad because it was the one place I looked forward to going to after work.
